followup_root.locations: Official MiSeq Custom Primers Guide 15041638 v01 pp1–8; official NextSeq 500/550 Guide 15057456 v03 pp1–5; Illumina PBMC demonstrated protocol lines 107–136, 283–318, 582–628, 794–824; nuclei demonstrated protocol lines 114–141, 285–323, 894–939, 1129–1157
followup_root.finding: The two instrument guides and both specimen variants now have independent second checks. They describe loading or specimen handling and name the supplied proprietary oligos, but do not print their bases. Other instrument guides and kit documents remain open, so no absence is accepted.

missing_claims.claim: SureCell proprietary bead oligo and custom Read 1 primer bases
missing_claims.evidence: Vendor guide names the components; instrument guides remain unchecked.

conclusion: Two independent readers checked the defining Illumina guide, kit checklist, later Bio-Rad kit, two official instrument Custom Primer Guides and both specimen-handling variants. Other instrument guides and historical kit-specific sequences remain unresolved. Exact SureCell bead, TPP1 and SP bases remain blocked; the page uses inferred placeholders.
